digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external live integration tests
propositions: rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed pre-1.0 but two external test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes (external LLM live anthropic/openai/bedrock and langfuse tracing)
external test modules were excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the removal epic's test suite never caught the stale call sites
review_plan() cannot substitute for review_ticket() in these tests because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings field, breaking existing assertions for runner/model/findings
both test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py must be retargeted to review_code() which returns REVIEW_RESULT and matches the tests' existing assertion contracts
